description:
Music video directed by Yoshihito Katou for the song Yume ja Nai by Hatena.

The video revolves around an RPG fantasy world expressed in what the director calls 3D-Pixstalgic CG, which is a fusion of pixel art and 3DCG. Seven characters travel through space and time and are depicted in a nostalgic new wave world view as they walk through the story of their lives.

Note: The song featured in this music video was also used as the ending theme in the anime Taisou Zamurai.
